{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 01 00}You don't even KNOW!
These new shirts totally
blow away spandex! 
{09 04 00}{07 15 00}And the best part is the
built-in parachute!

It's useful when you're
jogging and you accidentally
jog off a cliff.
You can pull off a killer
base jump!{03 02 00 01}

{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 15 00}Isn't it obvious?! It's so
tight that I have to fight
the shirt just to move!
{07 00 00}I can even hit a button
to eject a parachute for
even more wind resistance!
{07 0a 00}If you thought wind sprints
were gnarly, try running
with a parachute deployed!

{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 06 00}Huh? {01 00 00 0f 00}You mean, like a
wrestling move?

Ummmm, I don't really know
anything about wrestling,
but...
{07 0c 00}Wait, I've got it!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 00 00}You should
use your name as part of
your special move!{09 09 00}

{07 02 00}HWHAT?!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 05 00}Do you even know
what an electric-cage
match is all about?!
There aren't any rules!
It's NO-HOLDS-BARRED,
rip-roarin' wrasslin'!{09 09 00}
